methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $120M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Climate & Energy (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 9 same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Summit Lithium Technologies, a Series A climate and energy company founded by Amanda Hall, has raised approximately C$120M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers and one public comparable (Linz AG, LNZA), including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Only the stage-progression method proved applicable to this valuation. The peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—while nine companies operate in the sector, none met the minimum threshold of three datapoints after filtering by stage and valuation tier. The stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $240M from the $120M capital raised proxy.

The triangulation supports a median valuation of $240M, with a range bounded by $204M (low) and $276M (high), derived from sensitivity around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the reliability of using total capital raised as a valuation proxy in an early-stage context, the representativeness of a 2.0x multiplier for this specific sector and company profile, and the lack of actual peer pricing data to validate assumptions. Additional financial metrics—revenue, unit economics, or technology-specific milestones—would substantially improve confidence in this range.
